assessment.summary: This study investigates the discriminating concentrations of broflanilide for monitoring susceptibility in Anopheles gambiae s.l. vectors. It utilizes susceptible and resistant laboratory strains (Kisumu, Akron, Cov�) and wild populations from five villages in Southern Benin. While the paper mentions that the resistant lab strains carry L1014F and Ace-1R mutations based on previous characterization, it does not report any primary genotype data (counts or frequencies) for any of the mosquitoes used in the study. The results are focused entirely on bioassay mortality and lethal dose calculations.
exclusion_reasons: The study does not report extractable genotype data (counts or frequencies) for any of the target markers. It is a bioassay-only study that mentions the presence of resistance markers in lab strains based on previous characterization but does not perform or report new genotyping.
